description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Sedgemoor Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Pest.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.
